description: This file declares the WebAudioPlayerTaskFactory class, which implements the IWebAudioPlayerTaskFactory interface. It provides factory methods to create various WebAudioPlayer tasks such as play, pause, stop, set caps, and handle bus messages, for use within the Rialto server's Web Audio component.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerTaskFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating WebAudioPlayer task objects for various playback operations.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerTaskFactory
methods.description: Constructor initializing the factory with client and wrapper dependencies.

methods.name: createShutdown
methods.description: Creates a task to shut down the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createStop
methods.description: Creates a task to stop the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createPlay
methods.description: Creates a task to start playback.

methods.name: createPause
methods.description: Creates a task to pause playback.

methods.name: createSetCaps
methods.description: Creates a task to set the media caps with specified MIME type and configuration.

methods.name: createEos
methods.description: Creates a task to signal end-of-stream.

methods.name: createSetVolume
methods.description: Creates a task to set the playback volume.

methods.name: createWriteBuffer
methods.description: Creates a task to write audio buffer data.

methods.name: createHandleBusMessage
methods.description: Creates a task to handle GStreamer bus messages.
